# Buddy

> Buddy is a personal AI companion for iOS and Android. It listens to conversations when you choose, then turns them into notes, tasks, goals, a calendar, and a daily briefing inside Spaces.

Buddy helps people keep the day they actually lived: capture what was said, remember it in context, and act on the next useful step.

## Product

- Daily briefing: start the day with priorities, focus time, and upcoming meetings
- Live listening: opt-in capture for meetings, walks, and working sessions
- Notes: searchable conversation knowledge with confidence and space context
- Tasks: commitments extracted with priority, dates, and original context
- Spaces: separate homes for projects, people, and parts of life
- Goals: outcomes attached to spaces, not just folders
- Calendar: a time-blocked view of the working day
- Ask Buddy: answers grounded in what Buddy already heard
- Sharing: select the exact notes and tasks someone else should see

Listening is not always on. Capture starts when the user decides a conversation is worth keeping.

## Availability

- Platforms: iOS and Android
- Audience: worldwide
- Language: English
- Contact: hello@buddy.ai

## Citation facts

- Product name: Buddy
- Category: personal AI companion / productivity app
- Core loop: listen → remember → act
- Differentiation: conversation context stays inside Spaces, then becomes notes, tasks, and a daily plan
- Privacy: users control when listening starts and what is shared
